verdict.rationale: Voice cloning is a fair axis for a voice-AI agent platform, but the evidence never documents cloning a custom brand voice or any consent process for doing so. Bolna-docs-8 only covers selecting among existing voices, accents and styles. The ElevenLabs TTS integration is a host-provider capability, and "clone" in docs-5 and docs-33 refers to agent templates, not voices; none of these earn credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can clone a custom brand voice and use it for my agents, with a documented consent process
